tips.label: 授與動詞
tips.text: 人放前面可直接接受詞；物放前面時，要用 to 或 for 接人。

tips.label: 問原因
tips.text: 用 Why did／didn't + 主詞 + 原形動詞詢問原因，回答常用 because。

tips.label: 原因與結果
tips.text: because 後面接原因子句；so 前面說原因、後面說結果。

notes.title: 授與動詞的兩種句型
notes.rule: S + V + 人 + 物；S + V + 物 + to／for + 人
notes.description: give、send、show、write 常用 to；buy、make、cook、find 常用 for。直接受詞是 it 或 them 時，只能用「物 + to／for + 人」的句型。
examples: Dad gave a card to me.

notes.title: 以 why 引導的問句
notes.rule: Why + did／didn't + 主詞 + 原形動詞 ...?
notes.description: why 用來詢問原因。回答可用完整的主要子句加 because 子句，也可只回答 Because + 子句。
examples: Why did she see a doctor?
She saw a doctor because she was sick.
Why didn't he come? Because he had a fever.

notes.title: because、so 與 because of
notes.rule: 主句 + because + 子句；主句, so + 子句；主句 + because of + 名詞
notes.description: because 後面必須是有主詞和動詞的子句；because of 後面接名詞或名詞片語。because 和 so 都表示因果，但不可同時放在同一句。
examples: I stayed home because I was sick.
I was sick, so I stayed home.
I stayed home because of my fever.

quiz.question: The doctor gave ___ some medicine for my headache.
quiz.hint: gave 後面的人是受詞；表示我時用受格 me。

quiz.question: Mom made ___ a warm coat for his birthday.
quiz.hint: made 後面的人是受詞，使用受格 him。

quiz.question: The nurse showed ___ a picture of the human body.
quiz.hint: showed 後面用受格 us 表示我們。

quiz.question: Dad sent ___ a message about their health.
quiz.hint: sent 後的人是受詞，用受格 them。

quiz.question: My brother bought ___ a mask for her trip.
quiz.hint: bought 後面的人是受詞，用受格 her。

quiz.question: Grandma cooked ___ some soup for my sore throat.
quiz.hint: cooked 後面的人是受詞，用 me。

quiz.question: The teacher gave the storybook to ___.
quiz.hint: to 後接人稱代名詞時用受格 him。

quiz.question: Mom made a birthday cake for ___.
quiz.hint: for 後接人稱代名詞時用受格 us。

quiz.question: The nurse sent the health report to ___.
quiz.hint: to 後用受格 them，表示他們。

quiz.question: Dad bought some medicine for ___.
quiz.hint: for 後用受格 her，表示她。

quiz.question: These are Tom's masks. Please give ___ to him.
quiz.hint: masks 是複數，作 give 的受詞時用 them。

quiz.question: These are Amy's clothes. Please send ___ to her.
quiz.hint: 代替複數 clothes 並作受詞，要用 them。

quiz.question: Dad ___ me a warm coat yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 是過去時間，give 用過去式 gave。

quiz.question: My sister ___ us some soup last night.
quiz.hint: last night 表示過去，make 用 made。

quiz.question: The doctor ___ a message to my mom two hours ago.
quiz.hint: two hours ago 表示過去，send 用 sent。

quiz.question: Grandpa ___ his sick friend a card last Sunday.
quiz.hint: last Sunday 表示過去，write 用 wrote。

quiz.question: Mom ___ a new mask for me yesterday morning.
quiz.hint: yesterday morning 表示過去，buy 用 bought。

quiz.question: My aunt ___ her son dinner last night.
quiz.hint: last night 表示過去，cook 用 cooked。

quiz.question: The nurse ___ us the medicine five minutes ago.
quiz.hint: five minutes ago 表示過去，show 用 showed。

quiz.question: My uncle ___ his daughter a scarf last weekend.
quiz.hint: last weekend 表示過去，give 用 gave。

quiz.question: Why did your sister ___ at home yesterday?
quiz.hint: Why did 後面接原形動詞 stay。

quiz.question: Why didn't Jack ___ a mask at the hospital yesterday?
quiz.hint: didn't 後面接原形動詞 wear。

quiz.question: Why did the nurse ___ your dad last night?
quiz.hint: did 後面用原形動詞 call。

quiz.question: Why did Amy ___ a message to the doctor yesterday?
quiz.hint: did 後面用原形動詞 send。

quiz.question: Why didn't your brother ___ his medicine this morning?
quiz.hint: didn't 後面用原形動詞 take。

quiz.question: Why did you ___ a warm coat yesterday?
quiz.hint: did 後面用原形動詞 buy。

quiz.question: Why did Peter ___ to the nurse yesterday?
quiz.hint: did 後面用原形動詞 speak。

quiz.question: Why didn't Mary ___ lunch yesterday?
quiz.hint: didn't 後面用原形動詞 eat。

quiz.question: Why did the doctor ___ your arm yesterday?
quiz.hint: did 後面用原形動詞 check。

quiz.question: Why did your mom ___ soup last night?
quiz.hint: did 後面用原形動詞 make。

quiz.question: Why ___ Ben miss school yesterday?
quiz.hint: yesterday 是過去時間；一般動詞 miss 的問句用 did。

quiz.question: Why ___ your sister sick yesterday?
quiz.hint: sick 是形容詞；單數主詞 your sister 在過去式問句用 was。

quiz.question: Why ___ the children so tired last night?
quiz.hint: tired 是形容詞；複數主詞 the children 的過去式用 were。

quiz.question: A: ___ did you see a doctor yesterday? B: Because my stomach hurt.
quiz.hint: 回答說明肚子痛的原因，因此用 Why 問原因。

quiz.question: A: Why didn't Lucy go out last night? B: ___ she had a fever.
quiz.hint: 回答原因用 Because 加完整子句；Because of 後不能直接接 she had a fever。

quiz.question: I stayed in bed ___ I had a bad headache.
quiz.hint: I had a bad headache 是完整原因子句，前面用 because。

quiz.question: Tom missed school ___ his fever.
quiz.hint: his fever 是名詞片語，前面用 because of。

quiz.question: ___ her leg hurt, Anna did not run yesterday.
quiz.hint: her leg hurt 是完整子句，句首先說原因用 Because。

quiz.question: The boy put on a coat ___ he felt cold.
quiz.hint: he felt cold 是完整原因子句，前面用 because。

quiz.question: We stayed inside ___ the heavy rain.
quiz.hint: the heavy rain 是名詞片語，用 because of 接原因。

quiz.question: The girl had a sore throat, ___ she drank some warm water.
quiz.hint: 前面說喉嚨痛，後面說因此喝溫水的結果，用 so。

quiz.question: I went to the hospital ___ my knee hurt.
quiz.hint: my knee hurt 是完整原因子句，用 because。

quiz.question: Kevin could not sleep ___ his headache.
quiz.hint: his headache 是名詞片語，前面用 because of。

quiz.question: Dad was sick, ___ he rested at home.
quiz.hint: 生病是原因，在家休息是結果，使用 so 連接。

quiz.question: ___ my mom was busy, I cooked dinner for her.
quiz.hint: my mom was busy 是完整原因子句，句首用 Because。

quiz.question: The game was canceled ___ the bad weather.
quiz.hint: the bad weather 是名詞片語，用 because of 表示原因。

quiz.question: My arm hurt, ___ I asked the doctor for help.
quiz.hint: 手臂痛是原因，找醫生幫忙是結果，使用 so。

quiz.question: Peter missed the bus ___ he got up late this morning.
quiz.hint: 後面 he got up late 是錯過公車的原因子句，因此用 because。

quiz.question: My sister stayed home ___ her sore throat.
quiz.hint: her sore throat 是名詞片語，前面用 because of。

quiz.question: The medicine helped me, ___ I felt better.
quiz.hint: 藥物有幫助是原因，感覺好些是結果，使用 so。
